name: Jausenstation Oberberg
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Jausenstation Oberberg in Tirol!**

Discover the heart of the Alps at our cozy mountain stop, where fresh air and authentic Tyrolean hospitality await you. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, we offer a perfect break for hikers, cyclists, and travelers exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized, and served with a side of local jam or fresh fruit. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** soup or a hearty **Kaspressknödel** for a true taste of the region.

Our rustic wooden interior and panoramic views of the surrounding peaks make every meal an unforgettable experience. Whether you're refueling after a day of adventure or simply enjoying the alpine charm, **Jausenstation Oberberg** is your ideal stop in the mountains.

**Come visit us—your taste buds and soul will thank you!**
